source_text:
set $X=(\omega_1\times[0,1])\cup\{\omega_1\}$ and let
$\Sigma$ be the $\sigma$-algebra of subsets of $X$ generated by
$\{\{\xi\}\times E:\xi<\omega_1$, 
$E\subseteq[0,1]$ is Lebesgue measurable$\}$
target_text:
tetapkan $X=(\omega_1\times[0,1])\cup\{\omega_1\}$ dan misalkan
$\Sigma$ aljabar-sigma dari himpunan-himpunan bagian $X$ yang
dibangkitkan oleh $\{\{\xi\}\times E:\xi<\omega_1$,
$E\subseteq[0,1]$ terukur Lebesgue$\}$
